comments.en: Scenario orchestration — sequentially execute all sub-scenarios and output results.

comments.zh: 1. Fluent all-true: all four guards hit
comments.en: 1. Fluent all-true: all four guards evaluate to true.

comments.zh: 2. Fluent all-false (new instance): false condition -- keep default / initializer values
comments.en: 2. Fluent all-false (new instance): when conditions evaluate to false, retain default/initializer values.

comments.zh: 3. Fluent _Update: false condition -- keep dst existing values; true condition -- update
comments.en: 3. Fluent _Update: when condition evaluates to false, retain existing 'dst' values; when true, update.

comments.zh: 4. Attribute side [MapWhen]: property-level guard (predicate method declared on the DTO itself)
comments.en: 4. Attribute-side [MapWhen]: property-level guard (predicate method declared within the DTO itself).
